name: faq
description: Frequently asked questions accordion using native <details>/<summary> — zero JS, full keyboard support, works without scripts. Composes Section + Container + Headline + Eyebrow + Icon.

ai.whenToUse: Use to handle the most common pre-purchase questions (pricing, plans, refunds, security, who-it's-for). Best in the lower-middle of a marketing page — after pricing, before final CTA. 4–8 questions is the sweet spot.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for support docs (that's a docs site). Don't use for in-depth explanations — link out instead.

subheadline.example: Can't find what you're looking for? Drop us a note.

items.description: Question/answer pairs. Keep answers under ~3 sentences; link out for depth.

example.question: Can I switch plans later?
example.answer: Yes, upgrade or downgrade any time from your account settings. Prorated to the day.
